source: Wei Hao PhD thesis, Chapter 5, Chapter 6, and Appendix A.6
acceptancePolicy: A topological claim is reproduced only when the boundary-map event and an independent MIS/dual-repeller computation agree. Finding a periodic point of E is not sufficient evidence that it lies on the relevant normal bundle.

targets.acceptance: Track image curvature on an ordered MIS boundary. Confirm max(kappa_image)<16 below the bracket and >16 above it; confirm offset denominator 1-epsilon*kappa_image changes sign.

targets.sourceDiscrepancy: Page 98 says four saddle periodic points, while the Figure 6.6 colour convention and BIST's reduced spectrum at a=0.6 give four period-two points consisting of two stable and two saddle points.

supportedClaims: Continuation gives two stable period-two points and no saddle period-two points at a=0.59, then two stable and two saddle period-two points at a=0.6, with extended-state residuals below 1e-7.
notSupportedClaims: The reference grids do not support a refinement-stable change from one terminal-class MIS to two: the two finest grids report one class before and one after.
The reference grids do not support two simultaneous MIS/dual-repeller contacts: both dual-deficit thresholds report zero contact clusters at a=0.595.
The period-two manifold projection does not pass the bidirectional MIS-boundary comparison on the two finest grids.
evidenceStatus.interpretation: These finite-grid results do not prove the thesis claim false. They show that the current Euclidean Ulam refinement bundle is insufficient to label the topological split as reproduced.

targets.acceptance: Continue both period-two branches through their saddle-node; report the reduced classification explicitly, then show two MIS components after the event and two simultaneous MIS/dual-repeller contacts.
At 0.60764193 confirm the period-two unstable-manifold projection is not the MIS boundary; at 0.60785 confirm a period-14 orbit satisfies the manifold/MIS boundary test.
For every checkpoint, verify the projected one-dimensional unstable manifold against an independently refined MIS boundary; do not classify by period search alone.
Show the two disjoint minimal components reconnect and the continuously persisting larger invariant set becomes minimal.

Show bounded unstable-manifold projection at 1.16, unbounded projection at 1.17, and a stable/unstable manifold distance tending to zero inside the bracket. Label the heteroclinic cycle as suspected unless intersection is numerically certified.
Verify the unstable manifold crosses the dual-repeller stable manifold between the two parameter values and the compact MIS becomes non-compact.
